floater.name: wolf_sea_tunnels
floater.title: Sea Tunnels
floater.string: Making a glass piece in front of you...
floater.text: A sea tunnel is a glass tube with air inside. Inside it the water isn't murky and there's no sea surface, so trains, cars and people go through dry.

spinner.label: Length (m)
spinner.name: length
spinner.tool_tip: How long the piece is, metres (2 to 64). You can stretch it with Build afterwards.

spinner.label: Across (m)
spinner.name: across
spinner.tool_tip: How wide the tube is, metres (2 to 30). 8 m takes a train; 4 m a path.

floater.text: It lies the way you're facing, its floor at your feet. Move, turn, stretch and Shift-copy it with Build, end to end.

button.name: make_btn
button.label: Make a piece here
button.tool_tip: Make a glass tube piece in front of you, already filled with air

floater.text: Select cylinders, boxes, spheres or mesh tubes and fill them with air. This puts wolfdry in their description, which a script can also do with llSetObjectDesc.

button.name: plain_btn
button.label: Make ordinary
button.tool_tip: Take wolfdry out of the selected pieces' description: the sea comes back inside them

button.name: fill_btn
button.label: Fill selected with air
button.tool_tip: Put wolfdry in the description of every selected piece you may change
